name: Viganj (Pelješac)
notes: Pelješac channel; reliable afternoon maestral (W–NW) in summer, very gusty under the mountain. Little room to launch and land. Schools on site (FootLoose, Water Donkey, Maestral club).

name: Neretva delta
notes: Shallow river-mouth beach (Ušće Neretve); summer maestral in the afternoon, flat to small chop. Good for learning; schools on site.

name: Nin – Kraljičina plaža
notes: Shallow sandy lagoon-like beach; maestral (NW) and jugo. Standing depth, good for learning. Kite school (Surfmania) launches from Ždrijac beach, the sand spit east of Kraljičina.

name: Premantura (Kamenjak)
notes: Southern tip of Istria; best in jugo/scirocco (SE) and bora (NE), shallow flat water on the Stupice side. Launch from Stupice campsite. One guide reports a July–August kite ban on the main beach (no official text found, so no ban encoded). Kite schools listed on Unplug (FootLoose, Kiteschool North Croatia, Kanza).

name: Bol (Brač)
notes: Maestral accelerated by the Brač–Hvar channel, strong and gusty: experienced riders. Launch near Zlatni Rat is restricted in peak season, riders use spots 1–2 km away. Schools in Bol. Bol tourist board: launching on the Golden Horn is not allowed in peak season (no dates, no decree found: not encoded as a ban); riders launch at the kite school about 2 km away.
